description: Lab apps' image digests move as soon as their image changes and merge on green checks (the Renovate App bypasses the code-owner ruleset); platform updates (Argo CD, Kyverno, CloudNativePG, the PostgreSQL image, KSOPS, actions) wait for a code owner's review.

customManagers.description: The PostgreSQL image of the lab databases (database/cluster.yaml): a tag of the CloudNativePG project pinned by digest.

packageRules.description: Lab apps: digest bumps of ghcr.io/thomas-lg-lab/* in apps/*, at any time, auto-merged when validate is green. Renovate merges them itself through the API (platformAutomerge off): GitHub's native auto-merge never uses a ruleset bypass, so it would wait forever for the code-owner review the App is allowed to skip. The merge lands on the next Renovate run after the checks pass.
The PostgreSQL image stays on the major version the policy lab-databases allows; a new major is a change of that policy, made by hand.
Platform: reviewed by a code owner, never auto-merged.
